content:
Apple has officially announced its next product launch event, where it will unveil the iPhone 18 Pro series along with its first-ever foldable iPhone. The event will be held on September 9 at 10:00 a.m. (Pacific Time). This year's tagline is "Surprise and Shine," featuring a glowing Apple logo on the invitation with sunlight shining through it.

Apple 九月發布會有咩睇

Apple is expected to announce three new iPhones:

  • iPhone 18 Pro
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max
  • Apple's first foldable iPhone, reportedly to be named iPhone Ultra

This year's fall lineup is not expected to include a standard iPhone model. There are reports that Apple is splitting up its annual iPhone launches, with the iPhone 18, iPhone 18e, and iPhone Air 2 reportedly set to launch in spring 2027 instead.

The iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max are expected to retain roughly the same design and display sizes as the previous generation. This year's upgrades will focus on the new display, camera, and connectivity technologies.

Reports indicate three major upgrades: a main camera with a variable aperture, a smaller Dynamic Island, and Apple's own C2 cellular modem.

Apple may offer the new Pro phones in four colors: deep cherry, black, silver, and light blue.

Apple's first product with a foldable display: iPhone Ultra

However, the most anticipated announcement will be Apple's first foldable iPhone.

Reportedly to be named iPhone Ultra, the device is expected to feature a book-like foldable design, with an outer display size between 5.3 and 5.5 inches and an inner display size between 7.6 and 7.8 inches.

The foldable iPhone is rumored to come with a titanium frame, an ultra-thin design, and a nearly crease-less display.

It may use Touch ID integrated into the power button instead of Face ID, and feature two front cameras plus a dual-camera system on the back.

This will almost certainly become the most expensive iPhone in Apple's history. Most estimates point to a starting price of around US$1,999, though some reports suggest higher-spec versions could reach US$2,500.

Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 are also expected to get upgrades

We also expect to see two updated Apple Watch models:

  • Apple Watch Series 12
  • Apple Watch Ultra 4

Both watches are not expected to undergo major redesigns. Apple is reportedly focusing on upgrades to the new processor and health features. For now, no new Apple Watch SE is expected.

We do expect to see the AirPods 5, though the AirPods Pro with Visual Intelligence capabilities won't arrive until at least next year. Apple also recently announced new Mac mini and Mac Studio desktop hardware, scheduled to go on sale September 22.

This also marks Apple entering a new era of leadership. John Ternus will take over as Apple CEO on September 1, while Tim Cook will transition to the role of Executive Chairman.

Top comment by Mike Potter

I know I might be wrong saying this, but I really don't think Apple will name the foldable iPhone "Ultra." If the rumors are broadly accurate (though they may not be), I feel that with so many trade-offs in its design (such as battery, cameras, and no Face ID), it may not deserve that name. My gut says Fold.

All this and more will be revealed at Apple's iPhone 18 Pro and foldable iPhone event in September.

How to watch the iPhone 18 Pro event

Apple will stream the event live simultaneously on apple.com, YouTube, and the Apple TV app. The video is expected to be pre-recorded, with media in attendance in person at Apple Park in Cupertino, California.

As always, 9to5Mac will bring you all the details from the event as they happen. Keep following our coverage leading up to the event to learn more about Apple's iPhone 18 Pro series and its first foldable iPhone.

9to5Mac Editor-in-Chief Chance Miller will be attending in person.
